one_line: Cloud monitoring and observability platform for metrics, logs, APM, dashboards, and alerts.
auth_notes: REST API requires an API key (client identity) plus an application key (permission scope); OAuth2 for app integrations; personal access tokens and service account tokens also exist. Docs list 'API and Application Keys' and 'OAuth2 in Datadog'.
self_serve_notes: Free tier plus 14-day free trial; then paid plans. Keys are self-service in the UI.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Hundreds of endpoints across metrics, logs, APM, monitors, dashboards, events, security, workflows, synthetics, CI visibility.
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhook integrations for alerting/events; workflow automation actions.

existing_mcp.note: Datadog docs themselves list 'MCP Server' and 'MCP Tools' sections (Feature Flags, Experiments, Security, AI Observability MCPs).

evidence.note: Fetched text is the full API reference navigation confirming very broad REST surface, API/application keys, OAuth2, and MCP tools.
